decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR [ev-0253cf77c521] says what changed: the golang.org/x/crypto/acme package was forked into cert-manager's third_party folder with klone, "in preparation for patching the acme package to support ACME profiles", and the PR is self-labelled /kind cleanup. The changed files [ev-3746fc9594a8] are go.mod/go.sum, LICENSES, klone.yaml, make targets and pkg/acme client wiring. That is an internal dependency swap, with the upstream package replaced by an in-tree fork. The release note [ev-4fcf47388827] repeats this. The behaviour change itself is a separate item, ACME profiles support (#7777) [ev-7be235e771a3]. This is enough to write the change as an internal dependency replaced by a local fork that is not tied to any configuration. My confidence is low because the "no operator impact" consequence comes from the cleanup framing and the file list, not from an explicit upstream statement.
